Quantitative AI Scientist, Finance (PhD)   
 
 
 
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. 
 
 Who We Are: 














 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.














 
 
 Job Description: 
    
 Finance is increasingly using AI, advanced analytics and intelligent agents to support decisions and transform how work gets done. As these capabilities become more embedded in core Finance processes, ensuring they are trusted, consistent, accurate and mathematically robust becomes increasingly important. 

 The Quantitative AI Scientist will bring deep mathematical and analytical expertise to independently challenge, validate and stress-test AI models, agents and decision systems developed across Finance. 
 This role will go beyond traditional model validation. The successful candidate will help us understand where an AI solution works, where it breaks, how sensitive it is to changing conditions, and how confident we should be in the outcomes it produces. 

 What you'll do: 
 Stress-test AI solutions and models across a wide range of conditions, including edge cases, extreme scenarios, incomplete or noisy data, distribution shifts and adversarial conditions. 
 Design quantitative validation frameworks to assess accuracy, robustness, stability, consistency, reproducibility and reliability. 
 Challenge model assumptions and architecture , identifying weaknesses, hidden dependencies, biases and potential failure modes before solutions are deployed at scale. 
 Apply advanced mathematics, statistics, probability, optimization and simulation to independently validate AI-generated outputs and decisions. 
 Develop benchmarks, mathematical controls and deterministic tests against which AI and agentic solutions can be evaluated. 
 Quantify uncertainty and sensitivity, helping Finance understand not simply what a model predicts, but how much confidence we should place in the result . 
 Evaluate AI agents and multi-agent solutions, including how errors, uncertainty or unexpected behavior can propagate across interconnected processes. 
 Partner with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, Finance domain experts and technology teams throughout the development lifecycle, providing constructive and independent challenge. 
 Help establish standards for AI assurance and model governance across Finance, including testing methodologies and criteria for moving solutions into production. 
 Translate complex mathematical findings into clear conclusions for Finance and senior leadership, particularly around risk, confidence and fitness for purpose . 
 
 What we're looking for: 
 PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science or a closely related quantitative discipline. 
 Exceptional mathematical reasoning and ability to deconstruct complex systems and problems. 
 Strong grounding in areas such as probability, statistics, optimization, numerical methods, stochastic modeling, simulation, sensitivity analysis or uncertainty quantification. 
 Experience applying quantitative methods to machine learning, AI, complex decision systems or other computational models. 
 Ability to design rigorous experiments and testing methodologies rather than simply evaluate models against standard accuracy metrics. 
 Strong programming capability, ideally Python and relevant numerical/scientific computing frameworks. 
 Intellectual curiosity and a natural inclination to ask "under what conditions would this fail?" 
 Ability to operate across disciplines, connecting mathematics, AI, technology and business problems. 
 Finance experience is valuable, but deep quantitative expertise and problem-solving ability are more important than traditional Finance experience . 
 
 What success looks like: 
 This person will become part of the independent quantitative challenge capability for Finance AI . Their success won't be measured by how many models they build. It will be measured by whether we have greater confidence that the AI solutions we deploy: work when expected, fail predictably when they don't, and can be trusted when they matter.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

 What We Can Offer You:

 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
